plugins.name: competition-checker
plugins.description: Analyze startup competition terms & conditions. Evidence-first, neutral scorecard across 7 founder-calibrated dimensions. Flags what T&Cs say AND what they don't say. Investment-term deep dive (SAFE/convertible notes). Negotiation context with landscape comparison. Cross-competition side-by-side comparison. Founder-personalized fit and ROI analysis. Input-agnostic (URL, PDF, screenshot, text).

skills.name: competition-checker
skills.description: Use this skill when the user asks to review or evaluate a startup competition's terms and conditions, asks whether a pitch competition is worth applying to, shares a competition URL/PDF/screenshot and wants it analyzed, or mentions reviewing T&Cs for IP, equity, exclusivity, or publicity concerns. Input-agnostic — accepts URLs, PDF paths, screenshots, forwarded email text, or pasted clauses. Produces a neutral scorecard (markdown + JSON + PDF) with verbatim quotes, across 7 founder-calibrated dimensions. Adds a community-signal scan for recurring competitions. Falls back to browser automation when sites block AI fetchers. Diffs against any prior check of the same competition.
headings: 1. Identify the input and fetch content

commands.name: check
commands.description: Review a startup competition's T&Cs. Accepts URL, PDF path, screenshot, or pasted text. Produces markdown, JSON, and PDF.

commands.name: compare
commands.description: Compare 2–5 competitions side by side. Shows structural tradeoffs across all 7 dimensions in one view.

commands.name: diff
commands.description: Compare the two most recent checks of a given competition. Surfaces what changed in the T&Cs between versions.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List all stored competition checks and their dates.

commands.name: prune
commands.description: Remove older stored reports for a competition, keeping the N most recent. Never deletes sidecars referenced by active watches.

commands.name: sentiment
commands.description: Scan online community sentiment about a recurring startup competition. Themes with sources, no score.

commands.name: unwatch
commands.description: Stop a T&C watch before its deadline. Applies the watch's retention policy.

commands.name: watch
commands.description: Watch a competition's T&Cs for changes until its deadline. Supports multiple URLs per competition and auto-deprecates when the deadline passes.

commands.name: watches
commands.description: List all active, paused, and archived T&C watches.
